passages.text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made Zedekiah son of Josiah the king of Judah, and he reigned in place of Coniah son of Jehoiakim.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
He made Zedekiah the king of Judah.
Zedekiah was the son of Josiah.
Zedekiah became king instead of Coniah.
Coniah was the son of Jehoiakim.
passages.original: וַיִּ֨מְלָךְ־ מֶ֔לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ תַּ֗חַת כָּנְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָקִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלִ֛יךְ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל בְּאֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: But he and his officers and the people of the land refused to obey the words that the LORD had spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.
passages.sermon:
King Zedekiah ruled Judah.
Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, made Zedekiah king.
Zedekiah had officers.
There were also people in the land of Judah.
The LORD spoke words through Jeremiah the prophet.
Zedekiah did not obey these words.
His officers did not obey these words.
The people of the land did not obey these words.
passages.original: וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ע ה֥וּא וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וְעַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ אֶל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃

passages.text: Yet King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the priest, the son of Maaseiah, to Jeremiah the prophet with the message, “Please pray to the LORD our God for us!”
passages.sermon:
King Zedekiah ruled Judah.
Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, made Zedekiah king.
Zedekiah sent two men to Jeremiah the prophet.
The first man was Jehucal son of Shelemiah.
The second man was Zephaniah the priest, son of Maaseiah.
Zedekiah gave them a message for Jeremiah.
He told them to say, “Please pray to the LORD our God for us.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־ יְהוּכַ֣ל בֶּן־ שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗ה וְאֶת־ צְפַנְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־ מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־ יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹ֑ר הִתְפַּלֶּל־ נָ֣א בַעֲדֵ֔נוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people, for they had not yet put him in prison.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet.
Jeremiah moved freely among the people.
The people had not put Jeremiah in prison.
Jeremiah could come and go as he wished.
passages.original: וְיִרְמְיָ֕הוּ בָּ֥א וְיֹצֵ֖א בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ נָתְנ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בֵּ֥ית הַכְּלִיא׃

passages.text: Pharaoh’s army had left Egypt, and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard the report, they withdrew from Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh had an army.
Pharaoh’s army left Egypt.
The Chaldeans were attacking Jerusalem.
The Chaldeans heard a report about Pharaoh’s army.
The Chaldeans were besieging Jerusalem.
The Chaldeans withdrew from Jerusalem.
passages.original: וְחֵ֥יל פַּרְעֹ֖ה יָצָ֣א מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַיִּשְׁמְע֨וּ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַצָּרִ֤ים עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ אֶת־ שִׁמְעָ֔ם וַיֵּ֣עָל֔וּ מֵעַ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says that you are to tell the king of Judah, who sent you to Me: Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has marched out to help you, will go back to its own land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
Jeremiah was a prophet.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a message.
The LORD told Jeremiah to speak to the king of Judah.
The king of Judah had sent messengers to ask the LORD for guidance.
The LORD said, “Pharaoh’s army came out of Egypt to help you.
Pharaoh’s army will return to Egypt.
Pharaoh’s army will not stay to help you.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֤ה תֹֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הַשֹּׁלֵ֧חַ אֶתְכֶ֛ם אֵלַ֖י לְדָרְשֵׁ֑נִי הִנֵּ֣ה׀ חֵ֣יל פַּרְעֹ֗ה הַיֹּצֵ֤א לָכֶם֙ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה שָׁ֥ב לְאַרְצ֖וֹ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Then the Chaldeans will return and fight against this city. They will capture it and burn it down.
passages.sermon:
The Chaldeans are a powerful army.
They are enemies of Jerusalem.
They will return to Jerusalem.
They will fight against the city.
They will capture the city.
They will burn the city with fire.
passages.original: וְשָׁ֙בוּ֙ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְנִלְחֲמ֖וּ עַל־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וּלְכָדֻ֖הָ וּשְׂרָפֻ֥הָ בָאֵֽשׁ׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: Do not deceive yourselves by saying, ‘The Chaldeans will go away for good,’ for they will not!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks to the people of Judah.
The LORD says, "Do not deceive yourselves."
Do not say, 'The Chaldeans will leave us for good.'
The Chaldeans will not leave.
They will not go away.
passages.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל־ תַּשִּׁ֤אוּ נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָלֹ֛ךְ יֵלְכ֥וּ מֵעָלֵ֖ינוּ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּי־ לֹ֖א יֵלֵֽכוּ׃

passages.text: Indeed, if you were to strike down the entire army of the Chaldeans that is fighting against you, and only wounded men remained in their tents, they would still get up and burn this city down.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The Chaldeans are fighting against you.
You might defeat the whole army of the Chaldeans.
You might strike down every soldier.
Some wounded men might remain in their tents.
Even if only wounded men are left, they will still rise up.
They will burn this city with fire.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ הִכִּיתֶ֞ם כָּל־ חֵ֤יל כַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַנִּלְחָמִ֣ים אִתְּכֶ֔ם וְנִ֨שְׁאֲרוּ בָ֔ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְדֻקָּרִ֑ים אִ֤ישׁ בְּאָהֳלוֹ֙ יָק֔וּמוּ וְשָֽׂרְפ֛וּ אֶת־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: When the Chaldean army withdrew from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army, Jeremiah started to leave Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin to claim his portion there among the people.
passages.sermon:
The Chaldean army left Jerusalem.
They left because they were afraid of Pharaoh’s army.
Jeremiah was a prophet.
Jeremiah began to leave Jerusalem.
He wanted to go to the land of Benjamin.
He planned to claim his portion there.
He wanted to do this among the people.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּהֵֽעָלוֹת֙ חֵ֣יל הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים מֵעַ֖ל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם מִפְּנֵ֖י חֵ֥יל פַּרְעֹֽה׃ס וַיֵּצֵ֤א יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לָלֶ֖כֶת אֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֑ן לַחֲלִ֥ק מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּת֥וֹךְ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: But when he reached the Gate of Benjamin, the captain of the guard, whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah, seized him and said, “You are deserting to the Chaldeans!”
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet in Jerusalem.
He left Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin.
He came to the Gate of Benjamin.
At the gate, there was a captain of the guard.
The captain’s name was Irijah.
Irijah was the son of Shelemiah.
Shelemiah was the son of Hananiah.
Irijah seized Jeremiah.
Irijah said to Jeremiah, “You are deserting to the Chaldeans.”
passages.original: וַיְהִי־ ה֞וּא בְּשַׁ֣עַר בִּנְיָמִ֗ן וְשָׁם֙ בַּ֣עַל פְּקִדֻ֔ת וּשְׁמוֹ֙ יִרְאִיָּ֔יה בֶּן־ שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ חֲנַנְיָ֑ה וַיִּתְפֹּ֞שׂ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַנָּבִיא֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֶל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֖ים אַתָּ֥ה נֹפֵֽל׃

passages.text: “That is a lie,” Jeremiah replied. “I am not deserting to the Chaldeans!” But Irijah would not listen to him; instead, he arrested Jeremiah and took him to the officials.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet in Jerusalem.
Irijah was the captain of the guard at the Gate of Benjamin.
Irijah accused Jeremiah of deserting to the Chaldeans.
Jeremiah replied, “That is a lie.”
Jeremiah said, “I am not deserting to the Chaldeans.”
Irijah did not listen to Jeremiah.
Irijah seized Jeremiah.
Irijah took Jeremiah to the officials.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ שֶׁ֗קֶר אֵינֶ֤נִּי נֹפֵל֙ עַל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑יו וַיִּתְפֹּ֤שׂ יִרְאִיָּיה֙ בְּיִרְמְיָ֔הוּ וַיְבִאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־ הַשָּׂרִֽים׃

passages.text: The officials were angry with Jeremiah, and they beat him and placed him in jail in the house of Jonathan the scribe, for it had been made into a prison.
passages.sermon:
The officials became angry with Jeremiah.
They beat Jeremiah.
They put Jeremiah in jail.
The jail was the house of Jonathan the scribe.
People had turned Jonathan’s house into a prison.
passages.original: וַיִּקְצְפ֧וּ הַשָּׂרִ֛ים עַֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ וְהִכּ֣וּ אֹת֑וֹ וְנָתְנ֨וּ אוֹת֜וֹ בֵּ֣ית הָאֵס֗וּר בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֔ר כִּֽי־ אֹת֥וֹ עָשׂ֖וּ לְבֵ֥ית הַכֶּֽלֶא׃

passages.text: So Jeremiah went into a cell in the dungeon and remained there a long time.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet in Jerusalem.
Officials arrested Jeremiah.
They put Jeremiah in a dungeon.
The dungeon had cells.
Jeremiah entered one of the cells.
Jeremiah stayed in the cell for many days.
passages.original: כִּ֣י בָ֧א יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית הַבּ֖וֹר וְאֶל־ הַֽחֲנֻ֑יוֹת וַיֵּֽשֶׁב־ שָׁ֥ם יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃פ

passages.text: Later, King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah and received him in his palace, where he asked him privately, “Is there a word from the LORD?” “There is,” Jeremiah replied. “You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.”
passages.sermon:
King Zedekiah was the ruler of Judah.
He sent his servants to bring Jeremiah to him.
Jeremiah was a prophet who was in prison.
Zedekiah received Jeremiah in his palace.
He spoke to Jeremiah in secret.
Zedekiah asked Jeremiah a question.
He said, “Is there a word from the LORD?”
Jeremiah answered Zedekiah.
He said, “There is.”
Jeremiah gave Zedekiah a message from God.
He said, “You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַיִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ וַיִּשְׁאָלֵ֨הוּ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ֙ בַּסֵּ֔תֶר וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הֲיֵ֥שׁ דָּבָ֖ר מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ יֵ֔שׁ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בְּיַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל תִּנָּתֵֽן׃ס

passages.text: Then Jeremiah asked King Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you or your servants or these people, that you have put me in prison?
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the Lord.
King Zedekiah ruled Judah.
Jeremiah spoke to King Zedekiah.
Jeremiah asked the king a question.
Jeremiah said, “What sin have I committed against you?”
Jeremiah said, “What sin have I committed against your servants?”
Jeremiah said, “What sin have I committed against these people?”
Jeremiah asked, “Why have you put me in prison?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֑הוּ מֶה֩ חָטָ֨אתִֽי לְךָ֤ וְלַעֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ וְלָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּֽי־ נְתַתֶּ֥ם אוֹתִ֖י אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית הַכֶּֽלֶא׃

passages.text: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, claiming, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you or this land’?
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the Lord.
He spoke to King Zedekiah.
Jeremiah asked about the other prophets in Judah.
He said, "Where are your prophets?"
These prophets spoke to you before.
They said, 'The king of Babylon will not come against you.'
They said, 'The king of Babylon will not come against this land.'
Their words did not come true.
passages.original: וְאַיּוֹ נְבִ֣יאֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִבְּא֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹֽא־ יָבֹ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: But now please listen, O my lord the king. May my petition come before you. Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe, or I will die there.”
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
He spoke to King Zedekiah.
He said, “Now, please listen to me, my lord the king.
Let my request come before you.
Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe.
If you send me there, I will die.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה שְֽׁמַֽע־ נָ֖א אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ תִּפָּל־ נָ֤א תְחִנָּתִי֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַל־ תְּשִׁבֵ֗נִי בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְלֹ֥א אָמ֖וּת שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: So King Zedekiah gave orders for Jeremiah to be placed in the courtyard of the guard and given a loaf of bread daily from the street of the bakers, until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.
passages.sermon:
King Zedekiah was the ruler of Judah.
He gave an order about Jeremiah.
He told his men to put Jeremiah in the courtyard of the guard.
He commanded them to give Jeremiah one loaf of bread each day.
They took the bread from the street of the bakers.
They did this until all the bread in the city was finished.
Jeremiah stayed in the courtyard of the guard.
passages.original: וַיְצַוֶּ֞ה הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיַּפְקִ֣דוּ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ בַּחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָה֒ וְנָתֹן֩ ל֨וֹ כִכַּר־ לֶ֤חֶם לַיּוֹם֙ מִח֣וּץ הָאֹפִ֔ים עַד־ תֹּ֥ם כָּל־ הַלֶּ֖חֶם מִן־ הָעִ֑יר וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּחֲצַ֖ר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃
